$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Community-Spec-1.0. FPSOT applications event data (APP-088). The data holds identifiers, codes and instants only, never a party id, a reference number, an answer, a name or an address. A consumer reads the file by its id. The CloudEvents attributes follow API-101, and the subject is the id of the file.
